overall_notes: This paper focuses on Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) with a translator module that generates sub-instructions. While it involves NLG (instruction/sub-instruction generation), the primary evaluation focuses on navigation performance rather than NLG quality. Human evaluation is limited to basic followability checking. No traditional NLG automatic metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, etc.) are used.
